verdict.rationale: Appwrite's docs describe a full public API surface (auth, databases, storage, functions) that can be driven via SDKs, CLI, and even an official MCP server for LLMs, and probes confirm live docs (llms.txt, docs.md, CLI/MCP server pages) exposing this API. This is strong first-party evidence of a documented, programmatically drivable API suited to AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer confirmation of API completeness or a public OpenAPI/spec reference beyond vendor docs.
